import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a new column for total spending
df['Total_Spending'] = df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds']

# Create a new column for total children
df['Total_Children'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to show the relationship between Income and Total Spending, colored by Marital Status
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Income', y='Total_Spending', hue='Marital_Status', palette='viridis', alpha=0.7)

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Annual Income (USD)')
plt.ylabel('Total Spending on Products (USD)')
plt.title('Income vs Total Spending by Marital Status')
plt.legend(title='Marital Status', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
